Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
GRINDER, HAND, DOMESTIC 



1. Scope— Dimensions and other requirements of domestic hand grinder used for grinding spices and 
pulses, 

2. Material 

2-1 Grinding Plates — Malleable cast iron ( chilled ) and having hardness from 400 to 500 HV. 

2,2 Body and other Parts — Cast iron conforming to Grade 1 5 of IS : 21 0-1 962 ' Specification for grey 
iron castings ( revised ) ' or of better quality. 

2-3 Screws — Mild steel. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 . 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The feed worm shall be concentric with the bore in the machine body. It shall have wider spacing 
at the hopper side and converge towards the plate end. The feed worm shall be so designed that when 
it is rotated ciockwise the material snail be fed towards the piate end. A baii of 6 mm diameter shaii be 
fixed at the plate end as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.2 The teeth of grinding plates shall be sharp and equally spaced. 

4.3 The threads and serrations, wherever provided, shall be well formed and clean. 

4.4 The various components shall have good workmanship. 

4.5 The casting shall be free from blow holes, pits, cracks and other casting defects. 

4.6 The grinder shall be tinned by electroplating or dipping process. If required by the purchaser the 
outside of the grinder may be painted by stove enamel paint and the inside by tin dipping process. 
The tinning shall be done in accordance with IS : 1359-1966 ' Specification for electroplated coatings 
of tin (revised)' or IS: 5274-1 969 'Recommended practice for hot-dip tinning of plain carbon 
steer and painting shall conform to IS: 150-1950 specification for ready mixed paint, brushing, 
finishing, stoving, enamel, colour as required' or IS: 151-1950 ' Specification for ready mixed paint, 
spraying, finishing, stoving, enamel, for genera! purposes, colour as required \ 

5. Performance Test — A suitable amount of rice shall be fed into the hopper of the machine. The 
feed worm shall be rotated clockwise. The machine shall grind the rice in the form of a fine powder. 
While grinding, there shall be no excessive strain on the hands and the machine after this operation shall 
not show any sign of damage. 

6. Marking — Shaii be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark and the 
country of origin. 

6.1 ISI Certification i Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 30 October 1972
